summary: join_team/leave_team reject a roster change once the team holds an active entry in a TEAM_LOCKED stage (ST-004); transfer_captaincy is deliberately unaffected (role reassignment, not composition change). join_team also runs through policies.check_action(Action.JOIN) scoped to the team as subject, so an organizer-bound policy can deny joining server-side; both direct and invite-based joins share this single path.
